subject: Torterra
fact: Groups of migrating Torterra are frequently mistaken for moving forests, and smaller Pokémon often live their entire lives on a Torterra's shell.

subject: Brandon
fact: Brandon is the Frontier Brain and chief of the Battle Frontier's Battle Pyramid, awarding the Brave Symbol to Trainers who defeat him.

subject: Brandon
fact: Brandon is the strongest of all Frontier Brains and the first Trainer in the animated series to have officially caught and trained a Legendary Pokémon.

subject: Reggie and Paul
fact: Brandon defeated Reggie in battle, prompting Reggie to retire from competitive battling to become a Pokémon Breeder, and inspiring Paul's obsession with strength.

subject: Battle Pyramid Location
fact: Trainers could only discover the location of the Battle Pyramid after acquiring the other six Frontier Symbols.
source_ref: https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Brandon_(anime) @ In animation > History > Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire

subject: Battle Frontier Hall of Fame
fact: Defeating Brandon earned Ash a place in the Frontier Battle Hall of Fame and an offer to become a Frontier Brain, which Ash declined.
source_ref: https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Brandon_(anime) @ In animation > History > Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire

subject: Regigigas and Snowpoint Temple
fact: Centuries ago, Regigigas saved Snowpoint City from a volcanic eruption before going to sleep sealed inside Snowpoint Temple.
